PPP_ZDGNSS.PCFExplain this processShow detailsPPP_ZDGNSS.PCF

PRECISE POINT POSITIONING (PPP) - extended version As the basic version this PPP-BPE - computes coordinates, troposphere and receiver clocks - updates the coordinate/velocity files It may also compute - geocenter coordinates from all datum stations included in the PPP procedure, - pseudo-kinematic coordinates, - high-rate troposphere (15 minutes sampling), and These additional features may be enabled (or disabled) by specifying a non-blank/blank solution identifier for the corresponding PCF variable. Furthermore this BPE demonstrates both opportunities to pre-process the phase data for zero-difference processing: - RNXSMT: consistency check with the code measurements based on Melburne-Wuebbena linear combination (requires dual frequency data) - MAUPRP: a sophisticated interpretation of epoch-difference residuals based on PPP (requires precise satellite clock correction with the same sampling as the data are)
